hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && f=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))'); case "$f" in *.py) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; uv run ruff format --quiet "$f"; uv run ruff check --fix --quiet "$f" >&2 || exit 2;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && out=$(uv run pytest -q 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -20 >&2; exit 2; }
